actionErrors.INVALID_INPUT: Please check the values and try again.
actionErrors.NOT_FOUND: That item could not be found. It may have been removed.
actionErrors.DUPLICATE_NAME: A folder with that name already exists.
actionErrors.ALREADY_IN_RECIPE: That ingredient is already in this recipe.
actionErrors.INGREDIENT_IN_USE: This ingredient is used by an active recipe, so it can't be moved to the trash. Remove it from those recipes first.
actionErrors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: That stock-out is larger than the quantity on hand. Recount the stock or enter a smaller amount.
actionErrors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This stock change conflicts with one already recorded. Refresh and try again.
actionErrors.RECIPE_HAS_TRASHED_INGREDIENTS: This recipe uses ingredients that are also in the trash. Restore those ingredients first.
actionErrors.INGREDIENT_IN_TRASHED_RECIPE: This ingredient is still part of a trashed recipe. Delete that recipe permanently first.
actionErrors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: This category is used by one or more transactions, so it can't be deleted. Reassign or remove those transactions first.
actionErrors.INVOICE_LOCKED: This invoice has already been issued, so it can no longer be edited or deleted. Void it instead.
actionErrors.INVOICE_NO_CUSTOMER: Add a customer before issuing this invoice.
actionErrors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: That status change isn't allowed for this invoice.
actionErrors.PROTECTED_TRANSACTION: This entry comes from a sale and can't be edited or deleted here. Void the sale instead.
actionErrors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that. Financial data is available to managers only.
actionErrors.RATE_LIMITED: You're doing that too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.
actionErrors.EMAIL_FAILED: The email couldn't be sent. Please check the address and try again.
actionErrors.UPGRADE_REQUIRED: This feature isn't included in your current plan. Upgrade to unlock it.
actionErrors.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: You've reached your plan's limit. Upgrade to add more.
actionErrors.IMPORT_EXPIRED: This import preview has expired. Upload the file again to import it.
actionErrors.AI_EXTRACTION_FAILED: We couldn't read a recipe from that photo. Try a clearer, well-lit image.
actionErrors.USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: You've used all of this month's photo extractions on your plan. They reset next month, or upgrade for more.
actionErrors.ALLERGEN_CANNOT_DOWNGRADE: A recipe allergen can only be added or raised, never lowered or removed. Allergens from ingredients can't be suppressed here.
actionErrors.MENU_RECIPE_INVALID: One of the menu's recipes is missing or in the trash. Remove or replace that line, then save again.
actionErrors.RECIPE_IN_MENU: This recipe is used in a menu, so it can't be deleted forever yet. Remove it from the menu (or delete the menu) first.
actionErrors.PRODUCTION_RECIPE_INVALID: One of the production's recipes is missing or in the trash. Remove or replace that line, then save again.
actionErrors.PRODUCTION_NOT_EDITABLE: This production is planned and read-only. Reopen it to draft before editing.
actionErrors.PRODUCTION_INCOMPLETE: This production isn't ready to plan yet. Set a planned date and make sure every recipe is available.
actionErrors.PRODUCTION_STALE: Someone else changed this production while you were editing. Reload and try again.
actionErrors.PRODUCTION_NOT_COMPLETABLE: Only a planned production can be completed. Plan it first, or it has already been completed.
actionErrors.PRODUCTION_NOT_VOIDABLE: Only a completed production can be voided.
actionErrors.PRODUCTION_NOT_DELETABLE: A completed or voided production is permanent history and can't be moved to the trash.
actionErrors.RECIPE_IN_PRODUCTION: This recipe is used in a production, so it can't be deleted forever yet. Remove it from the production (or delete the production) first.
actionErrors.SUPPLIER_IN_USE: This supplier is the default for one or more ingredients, so it can't be archived. Change or remove those ingredient suppliers first.
actionErrors.SUPPLIER_INACTIVE: That supplier is archived. Reactivate it before assigning it to an ingredient.
actionErrors.PACK_UNIT_MISMATCH: That pack unit doesn't match the ingredient's measurement type. Use a weight unit for a weight ingredient, a volume unit for a volume one, and so on.
actionErrors.UNEXPECTED: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again.
actionErrors.PO_NOT_DRAFT: This purchase order has already been sent or cancelled, so it can no longer be edited. Cancel it and create a new one instead.
actionErrors.SUPPLIER_REQUIRED: Choose a supplier before sending this purchase order.
actionErrors.PO_EMPTY: Add at least one line before sending this purchase order.
actionErrors.PO_NUMBER_TAKEN: That purchase-order number is already in use. Choose a different one.
actionErrors.PO_LINE_INGREDIENT_MISSING: One of the lines points at an ingredient that no longer exists. Fix the lines before sending.
actionErrors.PO_NOT_RECEIVABLE: This purchase order can no longer receive a delivery. Only sent or partially received orders can be received.
actionErrors.PO_NOT_CLOSABLE: Only a partially received purchase order can be closed short.
actionErrors.PO_CLOSE_REASON_REQUIRED: Add a reason for closing this purchase order short.
actionErrors.PO_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This purchase order has received deliveries and can't be cancelled. Void the receipts first.
actionErrors.TASK_LIST_STALE: Someone else changed this list while you were editing. Reload and try again.
actionErrors.TASK_STALE: Someone else changed this task while you were editing. Reload and try again.
actionErrors.TASK_LIST_NOT_EDITABLE: This list is in the trash and can't be edited. Restore it first.
actionErrors.TASK_LIST_FULL: This list has reached its task limit. Split it into more lists.
actionErrors.TASK_ASSIGNEE_INVALID: That person isn't a member of this organization. Pick a current team member.
actionErrors.SALE_STALE: Someone else changed this sale while you were editing. Reload and try again.
actionErrors.SALE_NOT_EDITABLE: This sale has been posted or voided and can no longer be edited or deleted.
actionErrors.SALE_DATE_TAKEN: There's already a sale for that date. Void the old one first, then create a new draft.
actionErrors.SALE_INCOMPLETE: One of the sale's items (or a menu's recipe) is missing or in the trash. Fix that line before posting.
actionErrors.SALES_TAX_RATE_REQUIRED: Set your VAT rate in Settings before posting a sale.
actionErrors.RECIPE_IN_SALE: This recipe is used on a sale, so it can't be deleted forever. The sale keeps it as history.
actionErrors.MENU_IN_SALE: This menu is used on a sale, so it can't be deleted forever. The sale keeps it as history.
actionErrors.INGREDIENT_IN_SALE: This ingredient was sold or consumed by a sale, so it can't be deleted forever. The sale keeps it as history.
actionErrors.INVENTORY_AREA_STALE: Someone else changed this storage area while you were editing. Reload and try again.
actionErrors.STOCK_COUNT_STALE: Someone else changed this count while you were editing. Reload and try again.
actionErrors.DEFAULT_AREA_LOCKED: The default area can be renamed but not deleted — it holds your existing stock.
actionErrors.AREA_NOT_EMPTY: This area still holds stock. Transfer or count it to zero before deleting the area.
actionErrors.AREA_HAS_DRAFT_COUNT: This area has a draft count. Commit or discard the count before deleting the area.

hero.headline: Know what every dish really costs.
hero.subhead: PrepProfit turns your recipes, inventory and sales into one clear view of your margins, so you price with confidence instead of guesswork.

problem.title: Spreadsheets were never built to run a kitchen.
problem.subtitle: Formulas break, ingredient prices drift, and last month's numbers never quite add up. PrepProfit keeps every cost, recipe and sale in sync.

before.a: Margins are a guess until the month closes
before.b: One price change means editing dozens of cells
before.c: Costs, sales and stock live in separate files
before.d: Broken formulas quietly corrupt your numbers

after.a: Live margin on every dish as prices change
after.b: Update an ingredient once, see every recipe react
after.c: Recipes, inventory and finances in one place
after.d: Tested calculations you can actually trust

features.title: Everything you need to run on the numbers
features.subtitle: From the cost of a single dish to the month's profit, in one secure place.

costing.title: Recipe costing that updates itself
costing.body: Ingredient cost, yield and loss, hidden costs and live margin on every recipe. Change a price and see the impact instantly.

financials.title: Financials & break-even
financials.body: Track income and expenses, read clear dashboards, and simulate break-even before you commit to a price.

operations.title: Invoices, payroll & inventory
operations.body: Gap-free invoicing, employee shifts and period summaries, and an authoritative stock ledger with low-stock alerts.

ai.title: AI photo recipe extraction
ai.body: Photograph a recipe card and get a costed draft to review. Import ingredients and transactions from CSV or Excel.

security.title: Multi-tenant and secure by design
security.body: Every record is isolated to your organization at the database layer, with roles that keep sensitive numbers manager-only.

how.title: From recipe to real margin in three moves

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you start.

q1.q: Is my data private from other businesses?
q1.a: Yes. PrepProfit is multi-tenant by design: every record is scoped to your organization with database-level isolation, so no other business can ever see your data.

q2.q: Do I have to rebuild everything from my spreadsheets?
q2.a: No. Import ingredients, transactions and recipes from CSV or Excel, or photograph a recipe and review an AI-drafted card. You start with your real data.

q3.a: Pro and Business begin with a 14-day free trial. If you choose not to upgrade you move to the Free plan and keep your data. No card is required to start.

q4.q: How accurate is the AI recipe extraction?
q4.a: AI drafts are always reviewed by you before anything is saved. Nothing becomes a final recipe or ingredient without your confirmation.

q5.q: Can my whole team use it?
q5.a: Yes, with roles. Managers see financials and settings; kitchen staff get the operational tools they need, with sensitive numbers kept manager-only.

purchaseOrders.subtitle: Draft orders to your suppliers, then send them a PDF.
purchaseOrders.empty: No purchase orders yet. Create your first draft to order from a supplier.
purchaseOrders.noSuppliers: Add a supplier first, then you can create purchase orders.
purchaseOrders.noIngredients: Add some ingredients first, then you can add order lines.

builder.title: New purchase order
builder.lineIncomplete: Add at least one line with an ingredient and a quantity.

actions.sendBody: This freezes the supplier and line details and queues a PDF email to the supplier (if they have an email address). A sent order can no longer be edited.
actions.cancelBody: The order is marked cancelled. If a send email has not gone out yet it is stopped; if it already left, the supplier is sent a cancellation notice.
actions.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the draft purchase order. This cannot be undone.

receive.title: Receive delivery
receive.noLines: Enter a received quantity on at least one line.
receive.overBody: One or more lines receive more than was ordered. This is allowed, but please confirm.
receive.shortCloseBody: Mark the order received with the quantities delivered so far. No more deliveries can be booked unless a receipt is voided.

purchaseOrderEmail.subject: Purchase order {number}
purchaseOrderEmail.body: Please find attached purchase order {number} from {seller}. The order details are in the attached PDF.
purchaseOrderEmail.cancelBody: Purchase order {number} has been cancelled. Please disregard the earlier order.
